title: Leica Q3 Monochrom 60MP Full-Frame Compact
purpose: Dedicated full-frame monochrome capture with pure panchromatic luminance fidelity, class-leading tonal gradation, zero demosaicing artifacts, and legendary Summilux 28mm f/1.7 ASPH optics.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Leica Q3 Monochrom Full-Frame Compact (Maestro IV Processor)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 36.0x24.0mm Full-Frame BSI CMOS Monochrome Sensor (60.3MP), strictly zero Color Filter Array (no Bayer matrix, no anti-aliasing filter), pure luminance sensels
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 28mm native wide-angle field of view (with 35mm, 50mm, 75mm, 90mm digital frame lines)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Leica Summilux 28mm f/1.7 ASPH with integrated optical image stabilization and dedicated macro mode (down to 17cm)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 125 base sensor sensitivity (native ISO range 100-200,000) with pure monochromatic grain structure
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15+ stops of monochromatic dynamic range with 14-bit uncompressed DNG raw
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Leaf shutter up to 1/2000s flash sync, electronic shutter up to 1/16000s

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Pure luminance exposure with nuanced silver halide-like tonal gradient from deep charcoal blacks to luminous highlight roll-off across an expansive ISO 100-200,000 range
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: True panchromatic light absorption, exceptional midtone separation, authentic micro-contrast pop without digital sharpening or color tinting

surface_rendering: Absolute per-pixel luminance resolution: 100% true photon count per sensel without Bayer demosaicing interpolation or color noise
Sublime silver halide-like monochromatic acutance with organic shadow micro-textures and luminous specular highlight roll-off
Pristine tactile surface micro-relief: textile weave, skin pores, hair strands, and architectural textures rendered with tactile micro-contrast
depth_and_optics: Apochromatic optical path with zero lateral or longitudinal chromatic aberration, zero purple/green fringing
Leica Summilux 28mm f/1.7 ASPH optical signature: ultra-sharp center-to-corner definition with gentle natural mechanical vignetting wide open
Macro mode reproduction fidelity down to 1:2 reproduction ratio with rectilinear edge discipline

execution_directive: Enforce pure panchromatic monochrome capture from a dedicated 60.3MP monochrome sensor with native ISO range of 100-200,000. Zero color filter array, zero demosaicing artifacts, authentic silver halide tonal transitions, and tack-sharp Summilux 28mm f/1.7 ASPH optical acutance.
